summary.text: Ismail Mohamed is a Democratic state representative from Ohio who has represented District 3 since January 1, 2023, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An attorney born in Somalia, he is the ranking member of the Technology and Innovation Committee.

paragraphs.text: Ismail Mohamed was born in Somalia and lives in Ohio, according to Ballotpedia.

He graduated from Northland High School, earned a B.A. in political science and government from The Ohio State University in 2013, and earned a J.D. from the Ohio State University Moritz College of Law in 2017.

His career experience includes working as an attorney and as a telephonic Somali interpreter, and he was appointed to serve on the North-Linden Area Commission and on the Columbus Civilian Review Board.
Mohamed succeeded Haraz Ghanbari (R) in the Ohio House of Representatives and assumed office on January 1, 2023.
In the 2025-2026 session he serves on the House Judiciary and Transportation committees and is the ranking member of the Technology and Innovation Committee.
Bernadine Kennedy Kent (R) and Elegant Afriyie (Independent) are also on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot.
